purpose: Separate semantic correspondence from geometry so one host object can be lawfully rendered and operated through unequal projections and scales without becoming several objects.
laws: Projection or scale changes may reallocate space but do not change facet semantics.
A projection may suppress a channel only by declaring residue.
Unsupported operation or projection paths return SUPPORT=0 with a reason.
Editable projections obey GetPut and PutGet for the edited domain.
A projected operation is lawful only when its canonical counterpart is explicit and the operation square commutes within the declared equivalence.
Selection and multifocus survive projection and scale changes.
Authority is host-owned and cannot increase through projection.
Physical geometry, fit, load and irreversible actuation are canonical only when supplied by a physical host; screen placement is not evidence of physical truth.
Six offices are one reusable mapping preset, not a required ontology.

placement.law: placement contains no canonical payload; it points back to facet/object identity

scale_policy.compact: allocate recognition + address; details may become residue/inspector
scale_policy.room: allocate facets to surfaces/volumes while preserving facet ids
scale_policy.physical: bind only through measured physical host addresses
